counting_rule: Nine distinct source documents; repeated sections, version aliases and screenshots are not extra sources.

sources.title: GOV.UK Design System — Question pages
sources.version_or_locator: Live HTML observed on checked date: When to use this pattern; Back link; Asking multiple questions on a page
sources.read_scope: Guidance body and the exception for related questions in repeated internal work
sources.confirmed: Ask for needed information, allow valid uncertainty, avoid repeat entry, and permit related-question grouping when user research supports it.
sources.limitation: No measured effect for software design exploration or optimal question count.

sources.title: GOV.UK Service Standard — Understand users and their needs
sources.version_or_locator: Live HTML observed on checked date: Why it’s important; What it means
sources.read_scope: Problem, purpose, broader context and assumption testing guidance
sources.confirmed: Understand the wider task and test initial assumptions instead of treating an initial solution as the user's entire need.
sources.limitation: Does not authorize deleting the user's explicit implementation constraints or requiring a complete architecture.

sources.title: NASA Systems Engineering Handbook
sources.read_scope: Verification/validation; stakeholder goals; rationale/assumptions/design constraints; Appendix C requirements checklist
sources.confirmed: Requirements, intended-purpose validation and rationale are distinct; implementation constraints need rationale as well.
sources.limitation: Mission engineering procedures cannot be assumed to be suitable mandatory fields for exploratory software input.

sources.title: W3C Web Annotation Data Model
sources.read_scope: Text quote, text position and time-state selectors; normalization and change sensitivity
sources.confirmed: Selectors identify quoted or positioned segments; time state helps identify the relevant representation.
sources.limitation: A resolvable annotation target does not certify the interpretation; position offsets can drift.

sources.title: W3C PROV-DM: The PROV Data Model
sources.read_scope: Entity/activity/agent; derivation caveat; document provenance example; revision
sources.confirmed: Production, use, attribution and derivation can be distinguished, and shared activity does not itself prove derivation.
sources.limitation: The model is not a truth validator and leaves determination of derivation outside its scope.

sources.title: JSON Schema — Annotations
sources.version_or_locator: Live reference page: title/description, default, examples; not pinned to a validator release
sources.confirmed: Annotation keywords differ from validation; default does not fill missing values during validation.
sources.limitation: Non-validation tools may use defaults, and syntactic validity does not establish faithful intent.

sources.title: JSON Schema — object
sources.version_or_locator: Live reference page: Properties; Required Properties; null example
sources.read_scope: Optional property definitions, required keyword and absence versus null
sources.confirmed: Defining a property does not require it, and an absent property differs from a property whose value is null.
sources.limitation: The source does not assign null the application meaning 'unknown' or define an intent schema.

sources.title: Asking Clarifying Questions in Open-Domain Information-Seeking Conversations
sources.read_scope: Abstract, evaluation findings, oracle distinction, failure analysis and direct screenshot of Table3
sources.confirmed: NeuQS와 OriginalQuery의 facet별 MRR 비교에서 45% 개선·19% 악화를 보고한다. 각 facet의 값은 1~3턴 평균이다. Table 4의 악화는 관측이며, 어휘 불일치는 저자가 제안한 가능한 원인 해석이다. Oracle 최고값은 자동 질문기 보장값이 아니다.
sources.limitation: The study does not measure this product, current LLMs, Korean architecture inputs or user interruption cost.

sources.title: Principles of Mixed-Initiative User Interfaces
sources.version_or_locator: CHI1999; DOI10.1145/302979.303030; principles2–9 and editable LookOut guesses
sources.read_scope: Mixed-initiative principles and LookOut description; publication metadata checked on author's employer site
sources.confirmed: The paper treats uncertainty, interruption cost, reduced precision and editable suggestions as design choices.
sources.limitation: It does not establish an optimal question budget or AI decomposition benefit for this product.
